title: Partial-close/open symbols excluded from realized analytics
description: Symbols with partial closes (scale-outs) are excluded entirely from realized analytics. For swing trading with scale-outs, realized P&L on sold quantity disappears from timeline, drawdown, streaks, monthly stats, and win rate. Files: src/lib/engine/timeline.ts:70, src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:301, src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:943.

title: Monthly P&L misattributes all realized P&L to last trade month
description: Monthly P&L assigns a symbol's entire realized P&L to its last trade month. Repeated round trips in the same symbol across months will be collapsed into the final month. Files: src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:529, src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:568.

title: Auto Google Drive sync for journal + portfolio data
description: Implement automatic bidirectional Google Drive sync for all app data (journal entries + portfolio snapshots). No manual import/export buttons — sync runs on startup (pull/merge) and after every mutation (push, debounced 2s). Uses Google Identity Services OAuth with drive.file scope. Client ID stored in IndexedDB settings, configured via first-time setup modal in the header.
close_reason: Implemented: google-drive.ts (GIS OAuth + Drive REST), sync-service.ts (bidirectional sync, debounce, conflict resolution), DriveStatusChip (header status chip + setup dialog). schedulePush wired into portfolio and journal stores.

title: Pre-existing test failure: classifyTradingStyles 'handles all 4 categories simultaneously'
description: Test in analytics-sprint4.test.ts line 163 expects swing.count=3 but gets 9. The makeMatch helper sets holdingDays in the object but classifyTradingStyles likely re-derives holdingDays from buyDate/sellDate, and the helper uses default same-day dates. Related to zerojournal-react-krn trading-style logic issue.
notes: Plan: sa8 is the test manifestation of krn. makeMatch correctly passes holdingDays through the spread — issue is purely swing filter > 0 instead of >= 5. Fixing krn resolves sa8 with no separate changes needed.

title: FIFO matcher should match by ISIN for symbol-name changes (RELINFRA-T, TVSELECT -> TVSELECT-T)
description: FIFO matcher groups trades by symbol name, but corporate actions can change a symbol's name while keeping the same ISIN (e.g., RELINFRA-T, TVSELECT -> TVSELECT-T). Trades with the same ISIN but different symbol names should be matched together in FIFO. File: src/lib/engine/fifo-matcher.ts:25.
notes: Plan: Group by isin instead of symbol in matchTradesWithPnL. Two changes: (1) bySymbol->byIsin map keyed by t.isin, (2) FIFOMatch.symbol uses trade.symbol (sell's name = post-rename canonical name). Add test with same ISIN, two symbol names to confirm matching.

title: Best-style insight never fires due to capitalization mismatch
description: bestStyle is capitalized (e.g. 'Intraday') but insights code indexes with lowercase keys, so the best-style insight likely never fires with real analytics data. Files: src/lib/engine/analytics.ts (tradingStyles), src/lib/engine/insights.ts.
notes: Fix: insights.ts:113 changed styleName cast to styleName.toLowerCase() so key lookup matches TradingStyleResult keys (intraday/btst/velocity/swing). Updated test mock bestStyle/worstStyle to capitalized values matching real analytics output. Fixed test assertion to expect capitalized title.

title: Trading-style logic inconsistent — swing counts all overnight trades
description: Code counts swing as all overnight trades, including BTST and velocity, while the failing test expects exclusive swing-only trades. Files: src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:768, src/__tests__/engine/analytics-sprint4.test.ts:140.
notes: Plan: Fix swing filter in classifyTradingStyles from holdingDays > 0 to holdingDays >= 5 (exclusive buckets). Also update TradingStyleSection.tsx description from '>0 days (incl. BTST & Velocity)' to '>4 days'. calculateMonthlyExpectancy keeps swing=all-overnight (different concept, separate function). One-line engine fix + one UI label fix.

title: Open-position unrealized P&L recomputed incorrectly from buyValue/quantity
description: Unrealized P&L is recomputed from buyValue / quantity instead of using authoritative SymbolPnL.unrealizedPnL. This can be wrong with partial exits or broker cost-basis adjustments. File: src/components/analysis/OpenPositions.tsx:53.
notes: Plan: Use pos.unrealizedPnL (broker-computed, from Zerodha P&L sheet) directly. openValue derived as currentValue - unrealizedPnL for display/pct. tfoot total simplified to sum of pos.unrealizedPnL. Three spots in OpenPositions.tsx: row calc + two tfoot IIFEs.

title: Sharpe Ratio is not a true daily portfolio Sharpe for swing trading
description: Sharpe only uses sell dates with realized P&L, ignores non-closing holding days, then annualizes by sqrt(252). The docs also contradict the code on zero standard deviation handling. Files: src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:40, METRICS.md:35.
notes: Plan: (1) Expand returns series with zeros for trading days between sell dates (gapTradingDays = round(calDays * 5/7)). Existing consecutive-date tests unaffected (gap=0). (2) Fix METRICS.md example — change Day 2 sell price to 502.5 so std≠0 and 7.99 is valid. (3) Add test: swing trade has lower Sharpe than intraday with same per-close returns.

title: Timezone-unsafe date handling shifts dates for US timezones
description: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') shifts dates for US timezones — 2025-04-01 becomes 2025-03-31, mis-bucketing monthly/weekly P&L and volume. Also affects FIFO matcher symbol transitions (RELINFRA-T, TVSELECT -> TVSELECT-T with same ISINs). Files: src/lib/engine/timeline.ts:159, src/components/dashboard/MonthlyVolumeChart.tsx:28, src/lib/engine/fifo-matcher.ts:25, src/lib/engine/analytics.ts:128.
